title: datasette-maplibre 0.1a0
description: Release: datasette-maplibre 0.1a0 The first new Datasette geospatial plugin in quite a while! This one combines the excellent MapLibre GL library with OpenFreeMap , the free vector map server operated by Zsolt Ero (you should sponsor Zsolt on GitHub .) I built most of this with a single prompt to Claude Fable 5.2…
